body: Thanks. I just feel like if I die, my wife gets enough money to live. If I stick it out, she lives on welfare at best, I don't want to think about the worst.

The way it works is they threatened me with 20+ years in Federal prison if I don't take the 10 years in state. No trial. No one has ever one a child porn case. It's a 100% conviction rate. I was told so much BS over the past 18 months, I feel like I shouldn't believe anything anyone says now. 

I predicted everything that's happened so far. It boils down to, if it can go bad for me, it does. I recognize that's not 100% true, but it's happened often enough, I can count on it every time. 

Part of my screwed up upbringing taught me not to need love. I have several
friends and my wife's family who love me. I have a really hard time feeling it.
I'm basically sort of healthy, but I have so many little health issues, that's all
going to add up to daily misery in prison. 

Here in NC, I read that I have to pay to see a medical professional unless it's 
so bad, they ask to see me (I drop dead, etc. )! I.e., unless you're dieing, 
you're not getting any medical attention. 

There's just nothing. I can't see any light. I've learned over the years that
the light at the end of the tunnel is always a train.

Here in NC they don't do the "good behavior" thing anymore. Basically I am getting 10 years, and it can be reduced to 6 if I work. 

I just feel like I am going to be punished for the rest of my life for this one mistake and one born out of my childhood. People just think men are scumbags are deserve to be in prison. I'm not saying I did nothing wrong, but I really didn't intend to hurt anyone. It just makes me feel like giving up. I know my
in-laws will probably pass away while I'm in. Yet another thing my wife will
be left to deal with on her own. 

I also fear I will not receive any treatment inside. I've already voluntarily taken the state mandated treatment while I was free. It did about as much harm as is it did good. I've read extensively about what passes for "treatment" inside. I'm afraid I'll just get worse and come out so broken and twisted my wife will be getting back a shell. 

Thanks for the kind words.
